title: Health Insurance Claims Executive
summary: Health insurance claims executives decide hospital claims for Indian health insurers and TPAs (third-party administrators that process claims for insurers), approving cashless requests and settling reimbursement claims under the policy. Many hold BAMS, BHMS, BDS or nursing degrees and work in claims teams with medical officers and investigators.
dailyDuties: Review cashless pre-authorisation and enhancement requests from hospitals
Adjudicate reimbursement claims against policy terms
Scrutinise discharge summaries, reports and hospital bills
Raise query letters for missing documents
Apply agreed package rates for network hospitals
Refer suspicious claims to the investigation team
Close claims within turnaround time targets

skills.expectation: Review and decide cashless pre-authorisation and enhancement requests
Adjudicate reimbursement claims and calculate the payable amount
Scrutinise discharge summaries, reports and bills for medical necessity
Read diagnoses, procedures and treatment notes, usually with a medical degree
Apply policy terms, exclusions, waiting periods and sub-limits
Follow IRDAI health insurance and claim settlement rules
Coordinate with network hospitals on queries and agreed package rates
Meet claim turnaround and accuracy targets
Write clear query and deduction letters to hospitals and policyholders
Spot fraud triggers and refer suspicious claims for investigation
Assign ICD-10 codes to diagnoses on claims
Resolve policyholder claim queries and grievances
Prepare claims MIS and pendency reports
Track pending claims and TAT in spreadsheets
